fact: Xinhua reported on 1 December 2024 that Khartoum state schools were using the Ip School system, built on a large database of school data, and the state education ministry had set up an online platform to register candidates for the Sudanese Secondary School Certificate.
title: مدارس السودان تتجه إلى التعليم عن بعد لإعادة الطلاب إلى أجواء الدراسة
